title: The risks of a presidential campaign overshadowed by the spirit of defeat
subhead: Many French political leaders appear resigned to a showdown between the far right and the radical left, and are planning their next moves. Short on new ideas, mainstream parties are bogged down in political maneuvering, far removed from the stakes of the moment.

title: In California, thousands of Americans forced to live in their cars
subhead: Several thousand people live in a car, van or camper in the city of Los Angeles. The situation highlights the growing difficulties of low-income Americans to find stable housing, a major problem in the United States.

title: Albania's 'pink flamingo revolution' targets renowned architects
subhead: Architecture has taken center stage in the political debates of one of Europe's poorest nations. A broad social movement has, for months, denounced PM Edi Rama's corruption, after he launched several extravagant urban projects.

title: Annie Ernaux's words resonate among new generation of women: 'She doesn't try to make it poetic'
subhead: Annie Ernaux's books, which delve into the intimate side of the female experience, have found unprecedented resonance among women. The work of the Nobel laureate in literature echoed through the voices of two actresses – Tess Barthélemy in a film directed by her mother, Judith Godrèche, and Suzanne de Baecque in a solo stage performance – as well as in the powerful readings by high school girls in a documentary by Claire Simon.
